criterion.description: Given any service, when it starts, then structured logging is configured with JSON format (for production) and human-readable format (for development)
Given logging, when I check log output, then logs include timestamp, service name, log level, message, and context (user_id, conversation_id, request_id)
Given logging, when errors occur, then error logs include stack traces, error codes, and relevant context for debugging
Given logging, when I check log levels, then services support configurable log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) via environment variable
Given logging, when I check Docker logs, then logs from all services are visible via `docker-compose logs` with service filtering
Given logging, when sensitive data is logged, then API keys, tokens, and user personal data are masked/redacted in logs
Given logging, when performance issues occur, then slow operations (>1s) are logged with timing information

ecosystem.name: python-logging
ecosystem.note: No external dependencies - use built-in logging module

constraint.description: Logging overhead must be <1% of request processing time
constraint.impact: Use efficient logging patterns, avoid expensive operations in log formatting

constraint.description: Log format must be JSON for production (ENVIRONMENT=prod) and human-readable for development (ENVIRONMENT=dev)
constraint.impact: Need to create custom formatters based on ENVIRONMENT variable

constraint.description: Sensitive data (API keys, tokens, user personal data) must be masked in logs
constraint.impact: Reuse mask_sensitive_value from config.py, apply masking before formatting

constraint.description: Logs must be visible via docker-compose logs with service filtering
constraint.impact: Logs must go to stdout/stderr (standard Python logging behavior)

constraint.description: Use Python standard library logging module only
constraint.impact: Cannot use structlog or other external logging libraries

interface.name: backend/api/logging.py
interface.signature:
import logging import json from datetime import datetime from typing import Optional, Dict, Any from .config import get_config, mask_sensitive_value
def get_logger(name: str = None) -> logging.Logger: """Get configured logger instance""" # Returns logger with JSON or human-readable formatter # Based on ENVIRONMENT variable # Includes service name, timestamp, log level # Supports context fields (user_id, conversation_id, request_id)
class JSONFormatter(logging.Formatter): """JSON formatter for production logs""" # Formats logs as JSON with all fields
class HumanReadableFormatter(logging.Formatter): """Human-readable formatter for development logs""" # Formats logs as readable text
def log_performance(func): """Decorator for logging slow operations (>1s)""" # Logs operation name, duration, context
interface.description: Backend logging module with JSON and human-readable formatters
